title: Software Development Engineer
jobDescription: Hi there! I’m Satya Damera, your recruiter and guide to opportunities at CSG. We’re really excited to get to know you and learn more about your background. As a Full-stack .NET Software Developer within our Merchant and Partner Support team, you will play a key role in maintaining the stability and performance of CSG’s products and applications. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to help ensure that the tools and applications supporting Merchant and Partner operations are reliable, scalable, easy for internal teams to use, and aligned with business needs and industry standards. We are looking for a Software Developer who will: Design and develop new solutions using a variety of technologies such as but not limited to C#, .NET Core, .NET MVC, Java Script, j Query, Angular, CSS and HTML. Build and integrate web services and APIs using REST, .NET Web API, WCF, SOAP, and related technologies. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues with guidance from senior developers when needed. Improve and maintain database performance across platforms such as MS SQL and Postgre SQL. You will support new and existing applications as they are deployed and operate in multiple production environments. Collaborate with development, QA, product, and support teams to deliver high-quality software and resolve issues efficiently. Is this opportunity right for you? We are looking for someone who has: A Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or a related field. 2+ years of experience with C#, .NET Core, .NET MVC, Web API, Angular (or) React, and databases such as MS SQL (or) Postgre SQL. Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, software development concepts, and troubleshooting practices. Experience with AWS Lambda, WCF and SOAP is nice to have. Ability to read, write, speak and understand the English language in a business environment. CSGer Perks & Benefits Work from home, in-office, or hybrid Employee Belonging Groups Healthcare: Dental, Medical, and Vision Paid Vacation, Volunteer, and Holiday Time Off And so much more! title: Senior Developer
jobDescription: Are you passionate about software development for mobile network integration? Join our team to help take our telecom testing technology to new heights. The CSG Stockholm team is developing an advanced telecom testing software solution called CSG Assure used by mobile operators across the globe, including leading operators like AT&T, Tata, Orange. CSG Assure is an artificial test traffic generation platform consisting of a cloud-based application, controllers and test probes located in around 200 countries globally. We are looking for a skilled developer to be part of our small, agile team to build applications that help our mobile operator customers validate and optimize mobile service performance for their roamers and local subscribers. You will develop our next-generation mobile test probe for 3G, 4G, 5G and Io T to simulate mobile users using voice, SMS and data services. Main development is done in C & C++ on Linux platform. We think that you are a highly skilled, analytical, customer-focused person with a strong developer profile that enjoys taking responsibility, making sure our customers get full value of our high-tech solutions. Required Skills Completed Degree in Computer Science or related field 5+ years of professional experience in software development, preferably in telecom Strong proficiency in C++, data structures and multi-threading programming Linux system knowledge Solid understanding of the Radio Access Network (RAN) layer of mobile networks; the signaling and data exchange between devices and the network. Good knowledge of mobile network technologies (3G, 4G, IMS/Vo LTE, 5G, Io T) and network signaling (e.g. SIP, RRC, NAS) as defined in 3GPP Excellent Communication, problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. Bonus Skills Experience in development against cellular modems; experience with either AT commands, QMI, or modem vendor SDK Experience with network monitoring tools and protocol analyzers like Wireshark, QCAT Familiarity with scripting languages, e.g. LUA, Shell, Perl Understanding of e UICC/e SIM, GSMA standards Android development experience Why should you apply? Opportunity to work and grow your skillset in cutting-edge technologies Provide solutions to world-leading communication service providers Be part of a collaborative, innovative, international team Key Words: Senior Developer, Software Engineer, Mobile Networks, C++, Linux, Modem Communication, Telecom Software Location(s): India Remote Accommodation: If you would like to be considered for employment opportunities with CSG and need special assistance due to a disability or accommodation for a disability throughout any aspect of the application process, please call us at +1 (402) 431-7440 or email us at accommodations@csgi.com.
